newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dlr shortfall.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dlr shortfall.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.7600/7800 to the dollar in interbank trading on Wednesday against the previous 43.7500/7800 amid a shrinking supply of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at Tuesday's closing level and slipped further with dollar demand outweighing supply.
Dealers said many banks were considering raising their client charges as they were buying dollars from the market at rates above the limit set by the central bank.
The call money was traded at Tuesday's level at 5.5 to 6.5 percent, dealers said.
